description: Defines the SpdyNoOpVisitor class implementing multiple visitor and handler interfaces for SPDY protocol testing, with no-op method implementations.

classes.name: SpdyNoOpVisitor
classes.description: A no-operation implementation of SPDY visitor and handler interfaces for testing purposes.

methods.name: OnError
methods.description: Handles error events; implemented as a no-op.

methods.name: OnHeaderFrameStart
methods.description: Called at the start of a header frame; returns a handler interface.

methods.name: OnHeaderFrameEnd
methods.description: Called at the end of a header frame; no-op.

methods.name: OnUnknownFrame
methods.description: Handles unknown frames; implementation not shown.

methods.name: OnUnknownFrameStart
methods.description: Handles start of unknown frames; no-op.

methods.name: OnUnknownFramePayload
methods.description: Handles payload of unknown frames; no-op.

methods.name: OnHeaderBlockStart
methods.description: Handles start of header block; no-op.

methods.name: OnHeader
methods.description: Handles individual header key-value pairs; no-op.

methods.name: OnHeaderBlockEnd
methods.description: Handles end of header block; no-op.
